headword: {読書感想文|どくしょかんそうぶん}
reading: どくしょかんそうぶん

definitions.explanation: A written essay expressing one's thoughts and impressions about a book one has read. A standard school assignment in Japan, typically assigned as summer vacation homework.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{読書感想文|どくしょかんそうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: I'm writing a book report for summer vacation homework.

examples.japanese: {読書感想文|どくしょかんそうぶん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入賞|にゅうしょう}→入賞：11670_nyuushou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I won a prize in the book report contest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、{読書感想文|どくしょかんそうぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{後回|あとまわ}し→後回し：07398_atomawashi⟧にして⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I was bad at book reports and always put them off until the end of summer vacation.

notes:
USAGE:
One of the most well-known school assignments in Japan. The {青少年読書感想文全国コンクール|せいしょうねんどくしょかんそうぶんぜんこくこんくーる} (National Youth Book Report Contest) is a major annual event. Many Japanese adults have strong memories (often negative) of struggling to write {読書感想文|どくしょかんそうぶん} during summer vacation.
